[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/OriginalDescription.png[/img] [h2][b]Adds additional slaves to all slave-carrying traders and bases[/b][/h2]
[img]https://img.litet.net/s8csNp7.png[/img]
Increases the base amount of slaves from 0-2 to 2-4 for all vanilla traders, respecting the population limit. Additionally adds slaves above the population limit to all slave carrying traders depending on the mod setting. Default 3-5.
This is a re-write of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1541360626]More Slaves[/url] by Ziehn.
[img]https://img.litet.net/x3y72Eg.png[/img]
